label_provenance: Target = KNBS question eh09, owner self-reported performance 'Bad'. The label is NOT computed from any financial feature, so there is no direct definitional leakage.
leakage_policy: Profitability-derived features (net_income_last_month, net_income_margin, zero_or_missing_net_income) are EXCLUDED from the predictor. They are used only by the advice engine in the app.

feature_meanings.County: Typical distress rate of businesses in this county in the KNBS data.
feature_meanings.Sector: How businesses in this sector performed nationally.
feature_meanings.Male Owners: Number of active male owners (management depth).
feature_meanings.Female Owners: Number of active female owners (management depth).
feature_meanings.Stock (End): Inventory value at month end (sales velocity signal).
feature_meanings.Revenue Change Ratio: Last month's revenue divided by normal revenue (trend).
feature_meanings.Closed Any Establishment: Whether you closed a branch in the last 5 years.
feature_meanings.Revenue Declined: Your own confirmation that revenue is falling.
